description: Machine-readable manifest of every mountable @dwk worker, for composing apps (Anglesite/Anglesite-app#708). Worker ids are forever-stable; groups and componentIDs are coordinated with the consuming app. Validated in CI by scripts/catalog-gate.mjs; shape documented in spec/catalog.md. Provisional while this repo is pre-1.0 — breaking changes are paired-repo coordinated.

workers.description: Sign in to apps with your own domain: IndieAuth authorization, token, and metadata endpoints.
Publish posts to this site from any Micropub client, with a media endpoint for uploads.
Follow feeds and read them from any Microsub reader client.
Receive, verify, and send Webmentions for posts on this site.
Push feed updates to subscribers in real time (WebSub hub).
Make this site a Fediverse actor: follow and be followed from Mastodon and other ActivityPub servers.
Answer WebFinger discovery lookups for accounts on this domain.
Serve host-meta discovery documents for this domain.
Sign in with passkeys: a WebAuthn relying party for this domain.
Publish a did:web identity and issue or verify W3C Verifiable Credentials.
Expose a Solid-compatible personal data store for this site.
Mount the site's Solid Pod as a network drive over WebDAV, with per-app passwords.
Host a remoteStorage personal data vault for unhosted web apps.
Host your AT Protocol (Bluesky) account and repository on your own domain.

libraries.@dwk/calendar: JSCalendar/iCalendar event model and serializers — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/dpop: DPoP proof verification primitives — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/esi: Streaming Edge Side Includes response processor — composed around a Worker's responses, not a mountable endpoint (may become componentTied later).
libraries.@dwk/http-signatures: HTTP Message Signatures primitives — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/ldn: Linked Data Notifications primitives — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/log: Injectable structured-logging seam — consumed by every package, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/mcp: MCP server core the composed Worker embeds — its endpoint surface is composed by the app, not a standalone catalog worker (revisit with #240).
libraries.@dwk/oauth: OAuth 2.0 server building blocks — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/rdf: Turtle/JSON-LD parse + serialize over N3.js — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/safe-fetch: SSRF-safe outbound fetch primitive — consumed by endpoint packages, not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/store: DO-SQLite + R2 storage library instantiated inside consuming packages' Durable Objects — not mountable.
libraries.@dwk/wac: Web Access Control evaluation — consumed by @dwk/solid-pod, not mountable.
